description.en-US: A short detective story, first published in English Life in January 1925 as Dr. Hyde, Detective, and the White Pillars Murder.
description.pt-BR: Um conto policial breve, publicado pela primeira vez na English Life em janeiro de 1925 como Dr. Hyde, Detective, and the White Pillars Murder.

sources.edition: The White Pillars Murder (English Life, 1925), Project Gutenberg Australia, ebooks13/1301671h.
sources.description: Chapter divisions as printed; Gutenberg front and back matter dropped, line wraps joined, underscored italics converted, double hyphens set as em dashes. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Public domain in Brazil, the UK and the EU (Chesterton died in 1936). Published in 1925; text taken from Project Gutenberg Australia, which carries it under Australian law.
